text: Write to the person who taught you to cook.
Write to a teacher who will not remember you.
Write to the friend you text but never call.
Write to someone who was kind to you in a queue.
Write to a grandparent, about something ordinary from this week.
Write to the person who lent you a book you never returned.
Write to your neighbour. Just to say hello.
Write to someone you argued with and never quite fixed it.
Write to the one who moved away.
Write to a sibling about a memory only the two of you share.
Write to someone who is ill, about anything except their illness.
Write to the person who gave you your first job.
Write to a parent about a day they will not remember but you do.
Write to a child in your life, to be opened when they are eighteen.
Write to someone whose wedding you went to. Tell them what you remember.
Write to a friend and describe your kitchen in detail.
Write to someone you admire from a distance.
Write to the person who always drives.
Write to an old flatmate about the thing that broke.
Write to someone who is new in town.
Write to a colleague who left. Tell them what changed.
Write to a friend and ask them one question you have never asked.
Write to someone who made you laugh this month.
Write to the person who taught you to ride a bike, swim or drive.
Write to someone who is having a hard year. Do not give advice.
Write to a friend and recommend exactly one thing.
Write to someone you have only ever known online.
Write to your host from the last time you stayed anywhere.
Write to someone who does not know how much they helped.
Write to yourself, one year from now, and post it to your own address.
